chart.title: Rally > exhaustion top
chart.subtitle: Ask volume dries up at the high...

caption:
You buy when buyers QUIT. 📉

NQ grinds up into 24,580. On the footprint, the last four ticks of the high traded 520, 210, 60 and then just 4 contracts on the ask. Delta on the bar is still positive, so it looks strong, but aggressive buyers are disappearing tick by tick. That's exhaustion: not a big seller stepping in (that would be absorption, with heavy volume), but simply nobody left willing to pay a higher price. Late longs buy the top, the first sell imbalance prints and price rotates back down to 24,520.

1️⃣ Read the ask volume at the high: shrinking prints tick after tick = no fuel left
2️⃣ Don't buy a high where the ask dries up, even if delta is still green
3️⃣ The first sell imbalance below the high is the confirmation, not the dry-up alone
